Book correction: The answer key prints \frac{9}{5}\left(\cos\frac{7\pi}{12} - i\sin\frac{7\pi}{12}\right), i.e. an argument of -\frac{7\pi}{12}. But \frac{5\pi}{4} - \frac{\pi}{3} = \frac{11\pi}{12}, so the correct answer is \frac{9}{5}\left(\cos\frac{11\pi}{12} + i\sin\frac{11\pi}{12}\right) \approx -1.74 + 0.47i.
